_note: Numbers copied from the papers named here, read 2026-11-02 through alphaXiv. Nothing here was measured in this project. Each entry gives the arXiv id and where in the paper the number sits.

looped_masked.paper: Looped Diffusion Language Models (LoopMDM), Lee et al.
looped_masked.setup: 12 layers, 170 million parameters, layers 1 and 2 looped, loop count drawn from 1 to 12 in training (Section 4.1)

sudoku_errors_by_loop_count.where: Figure 4, one puzzle, fixed left-to-right order, one layer

adaptive_looped.paper: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models, Fang, Li et al.
adaptive_looped.limitation: Throughput depends on the input, and the speed advantage can reverse on unfamiliar domains (Section 5)

looped_uniform.paper: Looped Uniform Diffusion Language Models, Utpala et al.

loss_gain_by_diffusion_time.where: Figure 5b, top row, gain from loop count 1 to 12 on the uniform checkpoint

recursive_masked.paper: Recursive Scaling in Masked Diffusion Models (R-MDM), Carballo-Castro et al.
recursive_masked.where_dependence: Remark A.9; the conditional claim that loops cannot change the dependence term is in Appendix A

fixed_point.paper: Fixed-Point Masked Generative Modeling (CoFRe), Miele et al.

pure_self_conditioning.paper: Loopholing All the Way (LAW), Deschenaux, Ilieva et al.

correct_somewhere_vs_correct_at_end.where: Table 4, subset of the grade-school math benchmark

temporal_history.paper: TDLM: Adaptive Temporal Integration, Sun et al.

on_policy_residual.paper: On-Policy Residual Learning (ORL), Yu et al.

denoising_recursion.paper: Denoising Recursion Models (DRM), Cameron et al.

representation_supervised.paper: LoopREG, Wang et al. Image model on ImageNet, not a discrete diffusion model.

parallel_sampler.paper: Efficient Parallel Samplers for Recurrent-Depth Models, Geiping et al.
